method: Sandbox has no general outbound internet. Each URL below was fetched once with a page-fetch tool on 2026-11-01 and the returned title/body was read and compared against the ledger row. 'outcome' describes what the checker actually received. Nothing else in the dataset (195 of 206 rows) was re-fetched this session.

checks.pageTitle: 2026 CBSSports.com Pro Football Pick'em Contest Rules - CBSSports.com

Eligibility: legal residents of the 50 US states + DC, 18+ or age of majority.

notConfirmed: Prize amounts were not in the fetched section of the rules page.
checks.notes: Official rules page is live and on-topic. Free entry confirmed.

Live prize-bearing competitions were visible on 2026-11-01, e.g. ARC Prize 2026 Paper Track ($450,000), NFL Big Data Bowl 2027 ($100,000), Google Gemma 4 Developer Agent Paper Track ($35,000).

It is a tool for running your own pool; there is no operator-funded prize.

notConfirmed: The iOS listing could not be loaded.

Most likely the app is no longer available on the US storefront, but this is a single observation — flagged for manual confirmation, not asserted as removed.
checks.openEntryNote: Page did not load, so no entry window could be observed.

notConfirmed: No specific match prize table is stated on the App Store page.
checks.notes: Also served as the control for the App Store error above: apps.apple.com is fetchable, so the Solitaire Cash failure is not a blanket block.

notConfirmed: No NFL Survivor League rules or prize table appeared on the fetched homepage.

checks.openEntryNote: Survivor League entry was not visible on the fetched homepage; only sportsbook/casino promos were.

On 2026-11-01 every event shown on the landing page was marked Completed or pending, the most recent being October 7–20, 2026.
notConfirmed: The ledger's $50,000 / $10,000 / $7,000 table is not stated on the landing page.

checks.pageTitle: The Ultimate List of Writing Contests in 2026 • Win Cash Prizes!
confirmed: Reedsy's directory lists 458 contests.
Many listed contests charge entry fees — $5, $11, $12, $15, $20, $25 and $49 were observed in the fetched section.
notConfirmed: The ledger's prize text ('hundreds to tens of thousands') is a directory-wide range, not a prize for any single contest.
checks.notes: Directory is live, but it is not a free-to-enter resource: it is a catalogue that includes paid contests. Must be labelled that way on our site.

checks.pageTitle: Swagbucks: Get Paid for Games & Surveys | Earn Real Cash
confirmed: Site is live and free to join: 'It's completely free to join'.
'Swagbucks Daily Trivia challenges' are named on the homepage as one of the ways to earn.
Rewards are Swagbucks points redeemed for PayPal cash or gift cards — a points currency, not a direct prize pool.
notConfirmed: No cash prize amount for Daily Trivia is stated; the ledger's 'redeemable for PayPal cash / gift cards' wording matches, but no figure exists to verify.
checks.notes: Confirms the row is live but reinforces irregularity I-11: the prize is a points currency, not USD.
